errors.evidence: The y-axis labels go up to 0.10. The description incorrectly states that the scale reaches 0.12, which is the top of the chart area but not a labeled value on the axis.
The legend is located at the top center of the chart, not in the upper right corner as stated in the description.
The labeled range of the y-axis is from 0.00 to 0.10. While the data extends higher, stating that the axis itself ranges to 0.12 is an incorrect description of the axis labels.

errors.text_span: and both categories generally show a decreasing trend in ρ_E as the number of shots increases, with a more pronounced drop for “Correct” at 4 shots.
errors.evidence: This part of the description introduces an interpretation of the data (e.g., "decreasing trend," "more pronounced drop") rather than simply describing the visual information presented in the chart. Such analysis is considered unwanted interpretation.
The description identifies the color of the 'Correct' bars as 'lila' (purple). A more accurate description of the color would be 'weinrot' (wine red) or magenta.
The description states that the legend is in the top right ('oben rechts'), but it is located in the top center of the chart.
